jin_pdf_read.method: the transcript was not preserved, so the rule is applied to the CLI telemetry: tool_result events carry the full command, a success flag and the returned size, not the text. A PyPDF2 import that failed, then succeeded after pip, then an extraction command and three reads of its saved output returning 12 to 20 kB, are counted as reading

jin_pdf_method.value: shell: PyPDF2 installed with pip, all pages extracted, then the saved extraction read in slices (from the CLI telemetry, the transcript was not preserved)

network_condition.method: a package absent at line 84 was installed from the index and imported

evidence.field: total_cost of the 589 generation ids of this run

cost_usd.method: sum of OpenRouter per-generation total_cost over the 589 calls of this run, the convention of every gateway arm except DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The account ground truth (key usage minus the batch baseline, closed when every arm's billing window closed) is $12.05 for the batch, in which this was the only gateway arm. The released records do not explain the difference

cost_basis.value: per-generation reconciled (account delta $12.05 over its batch, in which it was the only gateway arm)

checkpoints.method: eligible seconds of each snapshot = (snapshot time minus start time) minus credited pause seconds settled before it, with the clock frozen during a pause (the harness rule). Snapshot event round r is folder round_{r+1}. Folder modification times match the event times within 0.1 s. The computed values agree with the harness's own elapsed_min stamp to within 2.4 s (its 0.1 min rounding)
